data.body: **[P2] Propagate fatal MDC restoration failures to the invocation caller.** This always publishes the previously selected result in `finally`. On an asynchronous executor, a direct or wrapped `VirtualMachineError`/`ThreadDeath` from `MDC.clear()` or `setContextMap()` therefore only escapes the worker, while Lambda may receive `SUCCEEDED` or `PENDING`; the inline path instead propagates the fatal. Detect a fatal restoration failure before completing `result`, complete `result` exceptionally with that fatal while still rethrowing it on the owner, and add an async regression asserting that the caller observes the same fatal.
